t: The Contactum Defender 1.0 is an 18-module, 10-way populated high integrity dual RCD consumer unit, designed for robust electrical distribution and circuit protection. This unit is compliant with 18th Edition Amendment 2 regulations and includes a 100A mains switch, a floating busbar, and a 40kA Type 2 surge protective device. It is ideal for domestic installations and light commercial applications, ensuring comprehensive safety for occupants and appliances. Constructed from durable steel with an IP2XC rating, it offers multiple cable entry points for flexible installation and comes supplied with a DIN rail and 10 Type B MCBs, alongside two Type A 100A 30mA RCDs.
b: 10 x Type B MCBs (3 x 6A, 2 x 16A, 4 x 32A & 1 x 40A)
